project.description: Single reactor build for the pic-sure monorepo. Runs `mvn -B clean install -T1C -DskipTests` once; every per-service image job docker-builds from THIS job's workspace. This is the ONLY Jenkins job that compiles monorepo Java.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: git_hash
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Branch or commit of hms-dbmi/pic-sure to build.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e
if [ -f "/usr/local/docker-config/setProxy.sh" ]; then . /usr/local/docker-config/setProxy.sh fi
GIT_BRANCH_SHORT=$(echo "${GIT_BRANCH}" | awk -F/ '{print $NF}') GIT_COMMIT_SHORT=$(echo "${GIT_COMMIT}" | cut -c1-7)
# Fail closed: image jobs must not consume a mixed workspace after a failed build. rm -f build-info.txt
# The single reactor build. Every per-service image job consumes this # workspace; no other job may run Maven against the monorepo. docker run --rm \ -v "$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/jenkins_home/workspace/$JOB_NAME/:/app" \ -v maven_m2_cache:/root/.m2 \ -w /app \ --platform=linux/amd64 \ maven:3-amazoncorretto-25 \ sh -lc "mvn -B clean install -T1C -DskipTests"
# Tag metadata for the image jobs (they source this file). { echo "GIT_BRANCH_SHORT=$GIT_BRANCH_SHORT" echo "GIT_COMMIT_SHORT=$GIT_COMMIT_SHORT" echo "PIPELINE_BUILD_ID=$pipeline_build_id" } > build-info.txt cat build-info.txt
